'''February 2002 Lafayette tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in The Game Preserve, Lafayette, Indiana on 24 February 2002. [[Brian Fred]] won it. It is known from David Brinson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3404">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-25-lafayette-ind-2-24d3404/ lafayette-ind-2-24], DeckTech (David "plasma26" Brinson, 25 February 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-25-lafayette-ind-2-24d3404/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 24 February 2002
* '''Site:''' The Game Preserve, Lafayette, Indiana
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Fred]]
